Let \(n=2310=2\cdot3\cdot5\cdot7\cdot11\). By symmetry,
\[
\sum_{abc=2310}(a+b+c)=3\sum_{abc=2310} a.
\]
For fixed \(a\mid 2310\), the number of ordered pairs \((b,c)\) with \(bc=2310/a\) is \(\tau(2310/a)\). Thus
\[
\sum_{abc=2310} a=\sum_{a\mid 2310} a\,\tau(2310/a).
\]
Substitute \(d=2310/a\):
\[
\sum_{a\mid 2310} a\,\tau(2310/a)
=2310\sum_{d\mid 2310}\frac{\tau(d)}{d}.
\]
Since \(2310\) is squarefree, this is multiplicative:
\[
\sum_{d\mid 2310}\frac{\tau(d)}{d}
=\prod_{p\mid 2310}\left(1+\frac{2}{p}\right)
=\left(1+\frac22\right)\left(1+\frac23\right)\left(1+\frac25\right)\left(1+\frac27\right)\left(1+\frac2{11}\right).
\]
This equals
\[
2\cdot \frac53\cdot \frac75\cdot \frac97\cdot \frac{13}{11}=\frac{78}{11}.
\]
So
\[
\sum_{abc=2310} a=2310\cdot \frac{78}{11}=16380.
\]
Therefore,
\[
\sum_{abc=2310}(a+b+c)=3(16380)=49140.
\]
\[
\boxed{49140}
\]
